-- Migration: add the new loyalty column to customers and backfill it
-- from legacy_code, using the code-to-tier mapping from codes.csv:
--   A -> gold, B -> silver, C -> bronze

ALTER TABLE customers
  ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

-- Any rows with an unknown or NULL legacy_code are left as NULL.
